tickerText: [TENNIS] US Open champion Alexander Zverev leads Germany into Davis Cup qualifying against Croatia while Ben Shelton heads a reshuffled U.S. team in Prague after Taylor Fritz and Tommy Paul withdrew • [SQUASH] World No. 1 Mostafa Asal reaches the Qatar Classic semi-finals in Doha and will face Marwan ElShorbagy as Hania El Hammamy and Sivasangari Subramaniam advance via walkovers • [BADMINTON] Shutters turn toward the Sept 19 Asian Games in Japan after Aidil Sholeh's Vietnam Open upset and An Se-young's seventh title of 2026 at the China Masters • [PICKLEBALL] The Veolia Arizona Open moves into pro round of 32 day in Mesa with 1,000 ranking points on the line and evening sessions built for desert heat • [TABLE TENNIS] Truls Moregard and Miwa Harimoto lifted the WTT Champions Macao singles trophies after Moregard beat Hugo Calderano 4-1 and Harimoto edged Chen Yi in seven games

newsItems.title: Davis Cup Week After US Open
newsItems.excerpt: Alexander Zverev returns for Germany's qualifier against Croatia days after beating Ben Shelton in the US Open final, while Shelton leads a depleted U.S. side against the Czech Republic in Prague.

newsItems.title: Asal Into Qatar Semis
newsItems.excerpt: Mostafa Asal beat Aly Abou Eleinen in four games to reach the Qatar Classic semi-finals, where he will meet Marwan ElShorbagy after injury walkovers sent Hania El Hammamy and Sivasangari Subramaniam through on the women's side.

newsItems.title: Aidil Wins Vietnam Open
newsItems.excerpt: Malaysia's Aidil Sholeh Ali Sadikin upset top seed Jason Teh 21-16, 21-14 in Ho Chi Minh City for his first BWF World Tour men's singles title since 2024 as the tour shifts focus to the Asian Games.

newsItems.title: Arizona Open Hits Round of 32
newsItems.excerpt: The PPA Tour's first 1,000-point open of 2026 enters pro round of 32 play in Mesa with top-four World Pickleball Ranking seeds byed to the round of 16 and late sessions scheduled for triple-digit heat.
